title: Sequence Builder
description: Place the first step of a sequence and check that the order starts in the right place.
learningObjectives: Place the first step of a sequence and check the order

params.description: Which sequence to build, such as a day or how a plant grows.

events.name: step_placed
events.description: The child placed one step into the sequence.

events.name: sequence_checked
events.description: The child checked that the steps are in order.

tutorGuide.intro: Put the steps in the order they happen.
steps: Look at where that step sits in the order.
observationPrompts: What has to happen before the next step?

misconceptions.belief: The steps can go in any order and still tell the same story.
misconceptions.response: This sequence only works when the earlier step comes first.

hints: Start with the step that happens first.
Morning comes before night, and a seed comes before a flower.

successCriteria.description: Placed a step in the sequence
Checked the order of the sequence

accessibility.screenReaderSummary: Tap the first step to place it and check the order of the sequence.
